The controls are simple yet responsive, using the 'WASD' or 'Arrow' keys for movement and 'W' or 'Up' arrow key twice for a double jump. sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Kanaksia 2 are centered around movement, jumping, and platforming. Your character can move left or right using the 'WASD' or 'Arrow' keys, while the 'W' or 'Up' arrow key can be used for jumping. The addition of a double jump allows for more complex jumps and maneuverability, adding a new layer of depth to the gameplay. As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter enemies, obstacles, and challenges that will require quick reflexes and strategic thinking to overcome.

One of the standout features of Kanaksia 2 is its level design. Each level is carefully crafted to provide a unique set of challenges and obstacles, requiring players to think creatively and use their skills to navigate through the terrain. The levels are divided into eight main areas, each with its own set of enemies, power-ups, and obstacles. As you progress through the levels, the difficulty increases, requiring players to adapt their strategies and techniques to overcome the challenges ahead.

The gameplay mechanics of Kanaksia 2 are simple yet addictive, making it easy to pick up and play but difficult to put down. The responsive controls and intuitive gameplay make it a joy to play, while the increasing difficulty and varied level design ensure that players remain engaged and challenged throughout their journey.

In addition to the core gameplay mechanics, Kanaksia 2 also features a range of power-ups and items that can be collected throughout the levels. These power-ups can provide temporary boosts to your character's speed, health, and jumping ability, allowing players to overcome obstacles and enemies that would otherwise be insurmountable. The power-ups are strategically placed throughout the levels, requiring players to think carefully and plan their route to ensure they collect as many power-ups as possible.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Kanaksia 2 are engaging, addictive, and challenging, providing a fun and rewarding experience for players of all skill levels.
